article.story: TROY, Ala. -- — Cobi Campbell put up 30 points as Troy beat Southern Miss 91-65 on Wednesday. Campbell went 11 of 16 from the field (6 for 9 from 3-point range) for the Trojans (12-6, 5-1 Sun Belt Conference). Victor Valdes scored 19 points, shooting 6 for 11 (2 for 5 from 3-point range) and 5 of 6 from the free-throw line. Thomas Dowd shot 5 for 10, including 1 for 4 from beyond the arc to finish with 11 points. Israel Hart finished with 12 points for the Golden Eagles (11-8, 5-2). Tylik Weeks and Dylan Brumfield each finished with 11 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
